EventDisplay.Name: 2026 Barrie Santa Claus Parade
EventDisplay.Description:
​The Barrie Chamber of Commerce is excited to announce the return of Santa! A night parade full of fantastic lights, colours and music.

This year's parade is scheduled for 5pm on Saturday, November 21, 2026. 

  • All floats must be fully constructed and decorated prior to arrival. Incomplete floats will not be admitted to the parade.

  • All entries must carry valid insurance, listing the Barrie Chamber of Commerce as an additional insured party.

    Download the Participant Guide here.
    Download the "How to Build a Float" guide here.

    Please note that all participants of the Barrie Santa Claus Parade must agree to the terms and conditions of the Participant Guide. Registration for the event will imply your agreement to those terms.

    Float Registration Deadline: Monday, November 16th, 2026 by 2pm. No refunds will be issued beyond this date & time.
EventDisplay.AdmissionDesc:
FLOAT ENTRIES are:
$250 Non-Member, commercial businesses
$200 Member, commercial businesses
$150 Non-Member, Not For Profit / Charities
$100 Member, Not For Profit / Charities

  • All floats must be completely built upon arrival at the parade.
  • Non-completed floats will not be admitted.
  • All floats must be decorated in the theme of the parade.
  • The parade is intended for the enjoyment of children rather than for the promotion of any particular business.
  • The only commercial vehicles that will be permitted to participate in the parade are those actually pulling the floats; no stand-alone vans, trucks, etc.


CANCELLATION POLICY: If you are unable to attend, please email tricia@barriechamber.com to cancel before 2:00 p.m. on the Monday prior to the event.

EventDisplay.Name: 2026 Barrie Business Awards Gala (BBA)
EventDisplay.Description:
Recognizing Excellence in Business and Corporate Community Service in Barrie

The Barrie Chamber of Commerce cordially invites you to a night of grandeur, celebration, and recognition at the annual Barrie Business Awards Gala. Join us as we shine a spotlight on the businesses and entrepreneurs who've displayed unparalleled excellence, innovation, and dedication in our thriving business community. Optional Black Tie, this is the premiere Barrie business event of the year!

Roaring 20's 
 

As we mark 100 years of the Barrie Chamber, we are not just looking back, we are celebrating the same spirit that brought business leaders together in 1926. A spirit of ambition, resilience and community.

So this year, we are going to celebrate like it is 1926.

An evening inspired by the energy and elegance of the Roaring Twenties, while recognizing the businesses and individuals who continue to shape Barrie’s economy and community today.


Program Highlights

Awards Ceremony: Witness as we honour the trailblazers and visionaries of Barrie's business community. Awards will be presented across multiple categories, recognizing a range of achievements and contributions.

Incredible Meal: The team at Liberty North under Chef Mark never fails to impress. 

Networking Opportunities: This is a prime opportunity to connect with fellow business leaders, stakeholders, and innovators from across the region. Forge new alliances or strengthen existing partnerships amidst the backdrop of a celebratory evening.

Tickets & Reservations

Reserve your seat at the most anticipated business event of the year. Celebrate the achievements, share the success stories, and be inspired by the passion that drives Barrie's business community. We look forward to commemorating the evening with you!

EventDisplay.Name: Bytes & Burnout: Balancing Tech and Human Well-Being in the AI Era
EventDisplay.Description:
Join this essential Chamber event to explore the hidden legal, operational, and human costs of integrating artificial intelligence into the workplace. Four expert speakers provide actionable strategies to protect your organization from uncritical automation.

  • Katherine Ritch explores how AI-generated HR policies and contracts can trigger massive legal liabilities, severance risks, and privacy breaches.

  • Janet Morozuk highlights the copyright traps and cease-and-desist risks of using AI-generated, rights-managed imagery for promotional materials.

  • Olayinka Madamidola teaches leaders how to recognize the quiet signs of workplace conflict and use a four-step framework to navigate technological transitions safely.

  • Sarah-Jane VandenBerg demonstrates through a live interactive exercise why generic, AI-generated recognition fails, offering tools for genuine team appreciation.

Protect your business, brand, and people by learning how to balance technological efficiency with compliance and empathetic leadership.

EventDisplay.Name: YMCA Block Party
EventDisplay.Description:
The YMCA of Simcoe/Muskoka is celebrating one year to opening of the new Barrie YMCA Centre of Community with a community-wide Block Party!

As part of Doors Open Barrie, we’re inviting the community to come together at the future home of the new Barrie YMCA for a fun, family-friendly day. Get a closer look at the progress being made, learn more about what’s coming to the community, and celebrate this exciting milestone with us.

The Block Party will feature:

  • A look at the progress of the new Barrie YMCA Centre of Community

  • Outdoor fitness classes and activities

  • Special announcements and community celebrations

  • Family-friendly games, crafts and activities

  • Nature-focused activities

  • Community partners and local organizations

  • Fun for all ages!

Whether you’re a longtime YMCA supporter, a future member, a nearby neighbour, or simply curious about what’s being built at 535 Bayview Drive, everyone is welcome!

Join us as we celebrate this exciting milestone and look ahead to the opening of a new Centre of Community that will bring people together, support health and well-being, and create opportunities for people of all ages and stages of life.

This is an outdoor event and will take place rain or shine, weather permitting.
EventDisplay.ContactDesc: Email us or visit our website for more details or to get involved!
